contentList.content: A light, shadow-like black bodysuit that allows the wearer to move like a shadow in combat, with agile movements.
A light, shadow-like black bodysuit that allows the wearer to move like a shadow in combat, with agile movements.
One platinum and white, one pure white as snow. Contains the power of yin and yang, converting fist strikes into sharp piercing damage.
Platinum and fabric cleverly combined, light and form-fitting yet extremely resilient. The wearer can freely switch between weapon and unarmed combat styles.
Gain the Fist to Claw technique when equipped with these gloves.
When channeling energy, your unarmed attacks use claws, dealing piercing damage.
When wielding weapons, you can choose to fight bare-handed, using flesh and blood against powerful enemies.
After hitting an enemy with unarmed attacks, movement becomes wind-like, increasing movement speed by 3 meters for 2 turns.
Light as a swallow, movement speed is increased.
